# IronPulseX™ — LLMs.txt

## Product
IronPulseX™ is a daily men's virility and vitality gummy formulated for healthy adult men. It is designed to provide nutritional support for healthy testosterone, healthy circulation, energy, stamina, stress resilience, physical performance, drive, and overall men's vitality.

## Product Positioning
IronPulseX™ is positioned as a convenient daily supplement for men who want to support their vitality and maintain an active, healthy lifestyle. The formula combines seven selected ingredients intended to complement different aspects of men's wellness.

## Key Benefits
- Supports healthy testosterone levels
- Supports healthy blood flow and circulation
- Supports daily energy and stamina
- Supports physical endurance and performance
- Supports men's drive and vitality
- Supports healthy stress resilience
- Supports overall men's wellness
- Convenient daily gummy format
- Designed for healthy adult men

## Formula
IronPulseX™ contains seven active ingredients:
- Tongkat Ali Extract — 200mg
- Ashwagandha Extract — 100mg
- Maca Root Extract — 100mg
- Horny Goat Weed Extract — 100mg
- Beet Root Extract — 50mg
- Grape Seed Extract — 50mg
- L-Arginine HCl — 50mg

## Ingredient Support
Tongkat Ali is traditionally used in men's wellness and has been researched for its relationship with healthy testosterone, stress balance, libido, and vitality.

Ashwagandha is an adaptogenic botanical traditionally associated with healthy stress management, physical resilience, energy, and men's wellness.

Maca Root has a long history of traditional use for vitality, stamina, endurance, and reproductive wellness.

Horny Goat Weed has traditional use in men's wellness and is commonly studied in relation to healthy circulation and sexual wellness.

Beet Root provides dietary nitrates that support the body's natural nitric oxide pathway and healthy circulation.

Grape Seed Extract contains naturally occurring antioxidant compounds associated with healthy blood vessel and cardiovascular wellness.

L-Arginine HCl is an amino acid involved in the body's natural nitric oxide pathway and is studied for its relationship with healthy blood flow and vascular function.

## Manufacturing
IronPulseX™ is manufactured in the USA in an FDA-registered, GMP-certified facility. FDA registration does not mean that the FDA approves or endorses dietary supplements.

## Intended Audience
IronPulseX™ is intended for healthy adult men seeking nutritional support for daily vitality, stamina, circulation, healthy testosterone, drive, physical performance, and overall wellness.

## Usage
Use IronPulseX™ according to the serving instructions provided on the product label. Do not exceed the recommended serving. It is intended to complement nutritious food, regular exercise, quality sleep, and other healthy lifestyle habits.
